title: The Third Will
author: Ines Sterling
blurb: Ansel Brightwater, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
